stateful_because: job states persist across calls; pop order depends on the full submit/fail history (FIFO tie-break, requeue-to-back); retry exhaustion is deep state; counters digest the whole history
bloat_character: validation rule-engine + duplicated standalone checks, state-transition table indirection, mirrored queue index/size, write-only history, unused helper + import, verbose loops
constraints: deterministic, no I/O, no wall clock, no randomness
